summary: Backend + mobile-web regression executed against public preview. FeedMe real GPT call returned valid non-zero per-serving macros and calorie-consistent suggestions; over-target remaining now shows negative/over correctly. Reaction decorator emitted unique buddy_reaction IDs across manual/batch/edit/duplicate/saved/water/exercise/weight flows, tiny 0.1/0.01 nutrition changes produced directional reactions, and full-state boundary behaved correctly (+99.9 not full, +100 full, delete reverses). Major unresolved issue: dedicated Premium QA account still remains plan=free after Test Store restore/purchase attempt; premium limits are still enforced and premium >100 saved-meals entitlement could not be validated end-to-end.

critical.issue: Premium QA account (qa.nom.premium@example.com) remains `plan: free`; usage limits stay finite (`meal_recommendation.limit=2`, etc.) after Test Store restore/purchase attempt. Premium bypass for AI limits and >100 saved meals is not active in real e2e.

integration_issues.flow: Premium purchase/restore (RevenueCat Test Store) -> backend entitlement mirror
integration_issues.issue: Paywall showed not-premium state, restore returned none, purchase confirm was attempted, but backend account still `free` afterwards; premium-only unlimited usage behavior not achieved.

action_items: Fix Premium entitlement sync path so qa.nom.premium@example.com becomes backend `plan=premium` after Test Store purchase/restore and no stale Free limit state remains.
Re-run full premium verification after fix: `/me/usage` limits null for all 3 AI types, FeedMe/scan/describe bypass exhausted usage, saved meals can exceed 100 and GET returns 101+.
Add focused e2e logging around RevenueCat identity + `/me/entitlement` calls to confirm purchase/restore lifecycle actually updates backend plan.
Optional follow-up test: force malformed AI output fixture and verify one retry + failed attempt does not consume free quota.
critical_code_review_comments: `frontend/src/api.ts` correctly gates paid-sensitive routes through `registerEntitlementSync` before request dispatch; implementation intent is correct but runtime premium mirror is still failing in tested account.
`backend/meal_suggestions.py` normalization and validation now robustly reject missing/all-zero/invalid nutrition and derive calories from 4/4/9 when absent.

`backend/routes_auth.py` entitlement endpoint trusts client-supplied `premium` flag; functional for mirror architecture but should be backed by stronger server-side verification for production-hardening.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% for requested scope (FeedMe/reactions/layout passed; Premium entitlement e2e failed)

seed_data_creation: Created missing dedicated QA account `qa.nom.reactions@example.com` and completed onboarding for qa.nom.free/premium/reactions accounts for testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium account currently returns `plan=free`; run premium checks only after entitlement-sync fix. Keep using public URL from frontend/.env. Existing legacy backend_test.py still has one outdated assertion (`Nailed it` vs `Nailed it!`) unrelated to this iteration.
rca_of_issue: Repro: (1) Login qa.nom.premium@example.com in web preview, (2) Open /paywall, (3) Restore purchases (shows none), (4) Attempt Start Premium + Confirm, (5) Re-check via `/api/auth/me` and `/api/me/usage` -> still `plan=free` and finite limits. Expected: backend `plan=premium`, usage limits null, premium gating removed. Mitigation: instrument and validate SDK identity binding and `/me/entitlement` sync after purchase/restore before allowing premium-gated requests/UI state.
